body.statement: There are universal constants \(0<c<C<\infty\) such that, for every admissible degree sequence, \[\Pr\!\left\{c\,r(n,d_n)\le R(G_n)\le C\,r(n,d_n)\right\}\longrightarrow1.\] The upper inequality is attained by the one-shot graph-measurable design-estimator returned by the finite compiler, and the lower inequality ranges over every graph-dependent assignment distribution and measurable estimator. This strictly tightens KandirosHarshawSavje2026Minimax, Corollary 5.4, from the factor-\(d_n\) interval \(d_n/n\lesssim R(G_n)\lesssim d_n^2/n\) to a matched order, and strictly improves the KandirosEtAl2024ConflictGraph generic \(d_n^2/n\) GATE upper scale by the factor \(\log(d_n+1)\).
body.justification: This resolves the full two-arm, all-procedure minimax order rather than optimizing a fixed estimator or exposing only one endpoint arm.
body.gap: The closest published result is KandirosHarshawSavje2026Minimax, Corollary 5.4, whose bounds differ by a polynomial factor \(d_n\); the January 2026 one-arm talk is not a full-GATE theorem.
body.consumer: ShiEtAl2020FreedomChoice motivates sizing a larger all-free versus all-fixed random-regular public-goods experiment by the explicit precision cost \(d_n^2/\log(d_n+1)\).

obligation.what_is_open: The high-probability minimax upper inequality and hence the matched two-sided frontier remain open.
obligation.obstruction: The lower bound and the finite attaining procedure are proved, but the procedure reaches the proposed rate only after the unresolved Boolean certificate event is established. Assuming that event would assume the theorem's crux.
obligation.attempted: Combined the proved balanced-hole converse, the direct switching packing theorem, the exact Rao--Blackwell estimator, and the Schur certificate. This closes every glue step and isolates the missing implication to Open-ended Question 1.
obligation.partial_result:
Proposition~\(\mathrm{prop{:}balanced\mbox{-}bayes\mbox{-}converse}\) and Theorem~\(\mathrm{thm{:}balanced\mbox{-}packing}\) already give a universal \(c>0\) such that
\[
\Pr\!\left\{R(G_n)\ge c\frac{d_n^2}{n\log(d_n+1)}\right\}\longrightarrow1.
\]
For the upper side, Proposition~\(\mathrm{prop{:}finite\mbox{-}compiler}\) proves the deterministic implication
\[
U(G_n,k_n)\le C_Ur(n,d_n)
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
R(G_n)\le\overline U(G_n)\le C_Ur(n,d_n).
\]
Thus the all-procedure lower frontier and the complete conditional upper glue are proved; only the probability-one-minus-\(o(1)\) certificate premise remains open.
